chunks: Topic: Email inviting team members for a meeting From: harshal@company.com To: teamMembers@company.com Subject: Upcoming Team Meeting – Project Progress & Task Planning Hi Team, I hope you're all doing well. I'd like to schedule a team meeting to discuss our ongoing project progress and plan the upcoming tasks. Please reply to this email with your confirmation or let me know if the proposed date and time are not suitable, so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Agenda: • Review of current project status • Discussion of blockers and challenges • Planning and assignment of upcoming tasks • Discussion and Q&A Your input and presence are important for this meeting, so please make sure to confirm your availability at your earliest convenience. As a reference, the proposed slot is 10 March 2026 at 11:00 AM (Meeting Room 2) — but we are open to adjusting based on the team's availability. Looking forward to our discussion. Best regards, Harshal Chopda Team Coordinator
